message.content:
Based on my search, Jay Ellis's height is reported slightly differently across sources, but he is generally listed between **6 feet 2 inches and 6 feet 3½ inches** (approximately 189-192 cm).

The most specific measurement comes from Celeb Heights, which reports him at **6 feet 3½ inches (191.8 cm)**. Other sources list him at 6'2" or 6'2½". The BET article mentions he stands at "almost 6-feet, 3-inches."

Sources:

2. https://www.whosdatedwho.com/dating/jay-ellis
3. https://www.bet.com/photo-gallery/xy9a84/jay-ellis-is-in-the-game/gej1ge
